attractions.name: Central Park
attractions.description: Large city park with a famous carousel, playgrounds, row boats, the Alice in Wonderland statue and Belvedere Castle
tips: Row boat rides are weather permitting

attractions.name: Times Square
attractions.description: Giant LED screens, M&M's World, Disney Store and costumed characters for photos

attractions.name: Bronx Zoo
attractions.description: Zoo with lions, gorillas, flamingos and a Bug Carousel, suitable for kids
tips: Take a cab back for a quicker return if kids are tired

attractions.name: Broadway - Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
attractions.description: Broadway stage show suitable for the whole family
tips: For a 7 PM show, arrive by 6:15 PM to 6:30 PM
Broadway theaters have airport-style bag checks and security that can take a few minutes
Theater doors open about 30–45 minutes before the show
Arrive early to buy merchandise or use the restroom before the crowd arrives

attractions.name: Circle Line Statue at Sunset Cruise
attractions.description: Sunset cruise with close views of the Statue of Liberty and the NYC skyline at golden hour; has restrooms, snacks and open-air decks, and is good for kids
tips: Circle Line Cruise Terminal is reached by subway (C/E to 50th St, then a 10-minute walk) or a short cab ride

attractions.name: 9/11 Memorial
attractions.description: A quiet, respectful memorial; children usually observe peacefully

attractions.name: Brooklyn Bridge
attractions.description: Walk across the bridge for sunset views and city lights; about a 10-minute walk from the 9/11 Memorial
tips: Visit Dumbo's Pebble Beach if time permits

attractions.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
attractions.description: Neo-Gothic cathedral in Midtown

attractions.name: LEGO Store
attractions.description: Play zones, giant models and build-your-own kits

attractions.name: Rockefeller Plaza
attractions.description: Prometheus statue, Channel Gardens and a seasonal ice rink

attractions.name: Radio City Music Hall
attractions.description: Historic venue that is lit up in the evening, worth seeing before dinner

attractions.name: Color Factory NYC
attractions.description: Interactive art experience with bright rooms, secret treats and photo ops for the whole family; located at 251 Spring St

attractions.name: Harry Potter Store
attractions.description: Store at 935 Broadway with wand walls, house robes and Butterbeer

attractions.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
attractions.description: Multi-sensory observation deck with mirror rooms, immersive art and sky-high views, near Grand Central; good for an evening visit

attractions.name: Empire State Building
attractions.description: Observation decks on the 86th floor and an optional 102nd floor with sweeping views

attractions.name: Fifth Avenue and Macy's
attractions.description: Shopping area with the iconic Macy's and LEGO, Nintendo and Disney stores

attractions.name: SPYSCAPE
attractions.description: Spy-themed attraction with hands-on challenges, codebreaking and a laser maze; ideal for older kids

attractions.name: Bryant Park
attractions.description: Free park to relax with a coffee or ice cream; may have live music, pop-up events, outdoor movies or storytelling sessions

attractions.name: The High Line and Hudson Yards Vessel
attractions.description: Elevated park with city views, gardens and art installations; the Vessel is a futuristic honeycomb-like structure
attractions.entry_fee: Free to view the Vessel from the base

attractions.name: Little Island (Pier 55)
attractions.description: Floating park with winding paths, lawns and occasional live performances; good for a sunset walk and for kids to run around safely

attractions.name: Seaport District & Pier 17
attractions.description: Cobblestone streets, waterfront views and pop-up family activities; often hosts free outdoor concerts or markets

attractions.name: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
attractions.description: Broadway show experience for the whole family

attractions.name: Statue at Sunset Cruise
attractions.description: Circle Line cruise with close views of Statue of Liberty and NYC skyline at golden hour

attractions.name: The High Line & Hudson Yards Vessel
attractions.description: Elevated park with city views, gardens, art installations, and futuristic honeycomb structure

hotels.name: The Time New York - JDV by Hyatt

transport_options.description: Quickest and easiest way to reach Manhattan from JFK Airport with luggage; takes about 1 hour
Useful for reaching sights such as the Circle Line Cruise Terminal (C/E train to 50th St, then a 10-minute walk); the 9/11 Memorial is about 25 minutes by public transport from Midtown
Quickest and easiest with luggage from JFK Airport to hotel, takes about 1 hour
C/E line to 50th St with 10-minute walk to Circle Line Cruise Terminal, about 25 minutes to 9/11 Memorial
10-15 minutes between hotel and Central Park/Times Square, attractions in Midtown within 5-10 minutes

season_notes.tip: In May, Bryant Park may have live music, pop-up events, outdoor movies and storytelling sessions
The Rockefeller Plaza ice rink is seasonal
